items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: And he came down and he heard us play. And he asked my daddy to let us come up in Meridian at Haven Institute.

ctx.x: Well, none of y'all had instructions other than from your father.

Well, no. Uh, we came up, and by his plane, and, uh, from out of town, we had, uh, Professor Randolph in Meridian, Mississippi. He had, uh, the old professor, he had a school at my home where we used to go to. And his son had, he was a principal of a big school in Meridian, Mississippi. And he came down and he heard us play. And he asked my daddy to let us come up in Meridian at Haven Institute.
All three of you at the same time? All three of us at the same time. I thought there was a larger age difference, though.
